newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Exp shares down on rating cut.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Exp shares down on rating cut.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Express Co Ltd were down in Thursday afternoon trade after a brokerage revised down the firm's rating on Wednesday, brokers said.
At 0513 GMT, the shares were down 45 yen at 842 yen, the ninth biggest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"Both foreign and institutional investors are selling to stop losses," a second-tier brokerage broker said. "Some dealers are also joining in the selling."
Nomura Research Institute Ltd downgraded Nippon Express Co Ltd to a "2" rating from its previous "1" on Wednesday.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "2" rating to issues whose values it sees moving within 10 percentage points in either direction of the key 225-share Nikkei average over the next six months.
